Notification-III
No. 1545-IB-Noti.-3- 2024.—
of Operation of Water User’s Association (WUA’s) on
hydraulic basis and as per Administrative convenience
under Sections 5, 6, 7 and Rule 3 of the MMISF Act,
2005. I, Shri. Rajiv Gosai Kurekar, Executive Engineer,
Bagh Itiyadoh Irrigation Division, Gondia hereby,
delineate Area of Operation of following WUA’s and direct
7 {ÉÖSUô ºÉÉ. Gò. 7245 ¨ÉÒ. 33 92 that the certified copy of the updated map and list of land
------------- holders and/or occupiers of said WUA’s shall be displayed
BEÚòhÉ. . 196 51 on the notice board of the offices of concerned Gram
Panchayat, Tahsil Office, Irrigation Section, Sub-Division
-------------
and Division & at other prominent public places.
Bagh Itiyadoh Irrigation Division, Gondia also hereby
declare that no water shall be supplied by the Appropri-
ate Authority to an individual holder or occupier of such
land and that system of supply of water through Water
User’s Association shall be binding on all the holders
and occupiers of the land under Management of Irrigation
--------------
System by Farmers.
Any person affected by this notification or part
--------------
thereof, may within thirty days from the date of
publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, file
Irrigation Circle, Bhandara.

Notification-III
No. 2729-Admin.-3-Laxmi-Dha.No.17A-WUA-2024.—
Whereas, it has been decided to delineate Area of
Operation of Water User Association (WUAS) on hydraulic
67 SÉEò xÉÆ. 74 4 56 basis and as per Administrative covenience under
68 SÉEò xÉÆ. 74 + 5 35 Section 5,6,7 and Rule 3 of the MMISF ACT, 2005.
I, Sandip D. Hase, Executive Engineer, Gosikhurd Right
Bank Canal Division, Bramhapuri hereby, delineate Area
of operation of following WUAS and direct that the certi-
71 SÉEò xÉÆ. 74 b÷ 4 66 fied copy of the updated map and list of land holders and/
72 SÉEò xÉÆ. 77 6 12 or occupiers of said WUAs shall be displayed on the
notice board of the offices of concerned Gram Panchayat,
Tahsil offices, Irrigation Section, Sub-Division and
Division & at other Prominent public places.
Now therefore I, Sandip D. Hase, Executive Engineer,
Gosikhurd Right Bank Canal Division, Bramhapuri,also
77 SÉEò xÉÆ. 79 5 54 hereby declare that, no water shall be supplied by the
appropriate authority to an individual holder or occupier of 78 SÉEò xÉÆ. 79 + 5 81
such land and that system of supply of water through
Water User Association shall be binding on all the
80 SÉEò xÉÆ. 82 10 07 holders and occupiers of the land under Management of
81 SÉEò xÉÆ. 83 12 16 Irrigation system by farmers.
82 SÉEò xÉÆ. 85 6 38 Any person affected by this notification or part there of
----------- may, within thirty days from the date of publication of this
notification in the Official Gazzette, file an appeal before
Superitending Engineer, Gosikhurd Project Circle, Nagpur.
